title: Account & key
covers: your AI key, at a glance

steps.say: {product} works with your own AI key, so the quality and the spend stay in your hands. Here is how to connect a key, set a budget and see every paid run.

steps.chapter: Your AI key, at a glance
steps.say: This card tells you whether a key is connected and ready. Everything in {product} that uses AI runs on the key you connect here.
No key yet? How to get a key walks you through creating one in Google AI Studio in about two minutes. A free key is enough to begin.
Press Add my key, paste it, give it a label so you remember whose account it came from, and choose the model. Save and test checks it with Google straight away; Google is the only judge of a key.
Test it re-checks the connected key whenever you like: useful after a billing change, or when a job refuses to start.
Choose the currency you think in, enter what you have budgeted and press Save budget. The meters show Budgeted, Spent here and Left, and every paid step checks this before it spends.
Your name, email and role, with Change password and About us - who we are and the build you are on - one click away.
Keep several Gemini keys and move between them. Make default decides which works first; Test, Lend and Remove sit beside each key.
Connect other providers and decide which one does the work. You choose; the portal never picks a paid model on your behalf.
Press Lend on one of your keys to let a colleague use it without ever seeing it. Their spend is billed back to you, shows under Shared keys, and you can stop lending at any time.
Key usage lists every paid run: which key, who ran it, what for, how long it took and what it cost. Search it by key, person or activity.
